# gitmoap_group_chat_apps (Data Source)

An organization's chat apps. Whether Gitmoap offers Slack, and the organization's connected workspace if it has one. For the organization's members.

The token needs `chat_apps:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_chat_apps" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `slack` (Attributes) A connected workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--slack))
- `slack_available` (Boolean) Whether Gitmoap offers Slack at all. When it is `false`, nothing can be connected.

<a id="nestedatt--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `slack`

Read-Only:

- `installed_at` (String) When it was connected.
- `revoked_at` (String) When it stopped working, if it has.
- `state` (String) `active`, or `revoked` once the app was removed from the workspace or its token withdrawn.
- `team_id` (String) Slack's id for the workspace.
- `team_name` (String) The workspace's name.
